rule: COMPOSITION_ONLY if no standalone decision; REJECTED if more wrong than baseline or significantly worse than baseline; EXPERIMENTAL if no significant edge over baseline (nor equal quality at >=1.25x lower median latency); SUPERSEDED if competitor significantly better and candidate wins none, or all ties and competitor >=1.25x cheaper; NICHE_CAPABILITY if beats baseline but significantly worse than competitor with some wins, or more wrong than competitor, or ties competitor at >=1.25x cost; DEFAULT_FOR_GEOMETRY if beats baseline, not significantly worse than competitor, no more wrong, and significantly better or <=1.25x competitor median latency. One-sided exact sign tests, alpha 0.05, 30 held-out seeds.

basal_bandit.baseline: epsilon-greedy (epsilon 0.1) after one pull per arm
basal_bandit.competitor: KL-UCB+ (KL-UCB index with exploration log(t / N_a); Kaufmann 2018)

basal_breaker.competitor: standard consecutive-failure circuit breaker (open after 3 consecutive failures, one-probe half-open) with the same cost-balanced break duration

basal_hysteresis.competitor: causal two-state HMM forward (Wonham) filter with the declared levels, noise and dwell; posterior log-odds margin tuned by simulating the declared model

basal_kalman.competitor: alpha-beta (Holt level + trend) filter with alpha, beta minimising one-step prediction error on the first 20%

basal_pid.baseline: on-off relay with a hysteresis band of twice the noise sd
basal_pid.competitor: simulation-optimised PI: Nelder-Mead on (log Kc, log Ti) minimising the declared cost on the declared FOPDT model with an independent noise realisation, started from AMIGO

causal_backdoor.baseline: naive difference in means (no adjustment, no identification check)
causal_backdoor.competitor: backdoor gate (NetworkX d-separation) + doubly robust AIPW: logistic propensity (IRLS) and a least-squares outcome model per arm (the IPW-only arm is kept as causal_ipw)

collective_immune.competitor: exact Gaussian prediction ellipsoid (Hotelling: sample mean/covariance, F quantile) at the same 0.75 x tolerance target (scipy for the quantile)

collective_market.baseline: posted reserve price + pro-rata rationing by request
collective_market.competitor: centralized optimum with full knowledge of every private value (an upper bound that uses information the market never sees)

collective_physarum.baseline: minimum spanning Steiner tree (KMB metric-closure MST, expanded and pruned)
collective_physarum.competitor: multi-start Steiner heuristics (KMB + Takahashi-Matsuyama from each terminal) each improved by best-improvement local search on the same objective (bridge-bypass paths, single-edge additions and removals)

collective_quorum.baseline: simple majority of all observers (each counted as independent; ties abstain)
collective_quorum.competitor: one vote per declared independence group (the group's accuracy-weighted majority, weighted by the log-odds of its mean accuracy); uses the same grouping and accuracies, no likelihood model

control_mpc.baseline: saturated PD (state-proportional) controller, critically damped at w = (q/r)^(1/4)
control_mpc.competitor: infinite-horizon discrete LQR (SciPy DARE) with input clipping

develop_constraint_release.baseline: the original fixed pipeline ATC(k=2) -> adjacent swap -> insert(window 2)
develop_constraint_release.competitor: random-restart configuration search with the same evaluation budget and retain rule

develop_repair.baseline: no repair: keep the pre-damage forwarding field, act never, claim nothing
develop_repair.competitor: adaptive centralized replanner: global BFS shortest-path rebuild on its view at every change, reliable pushes; reliable or predeclared-unreliable (crash / stale view)

dp_knapsack.baseline: greedy by value density (take every item that still fits)
dp_knapsack.competitor: OR-Tools KnapsackSolver, branch and bound (the library's dedicated 0/1 knapsack solver; replaced CP-SAT, a general CP model, in review)

flow_maxflow.baseline: min(capacity out of source, capacity into sink) - the bound read off without flow reasoning (greedy augmentation without undo is kept as maxflow_greedy_paths: on these digraphs it matched the optimum on every development seed)

flow_reinforce_greedy.baseline: round-robin spread over source and sink edges
flow_reinforce_greedy.competitor: exact optimum via graph_then_allocate composition (compile + CP-SAT)

forecast_quantile.baseline: naive last value with Gaussian random-walk quantiles
forecast_quantile.competitor: Theta method with the same empirical error quantiles

game_minimax.baseline: pure security strategies (maximin row, minimax column); replaced uniform play in review
game_minimax.competitor: one HiGHS LP in GREG's existing cognition.game formulation, column strategy from its dual marginals; replaced 5000-iteration fictitious play in review

info_experiment.competitor: best, by exact expected value, of adaptive uncertainty sampling, a fixed expert order, one-step greedy on the declared objective (Bayes-risk value of information) and a two-step lookahead on that objective

mc_importance.baseline: crude Monte Carlo at the same sample budget (abstains when it sees no hits)
mc_importance.competitor: Lugannani-Rice saddle-point approximation from the closed-form CGF (the CLT normal approximation is the weaker analytic option and is not used)

mech_vcg.baseline: pay-as-bid auction; bidders shade by a class-symmetric factor from a simulated iterated best response
mech_vcg.competitor: uniform-price auction (highest rejected bid); bidders reduce demand on later units by a class-symmetric factor from a simulated iterated best response

queue_erlang.competitor: square-root (Halfin-Whitt) staffing with the QED delay probability and wait-time tail

search_astar.competitor: SciPy csgraph Dijkstra (compiled) on the equivalent weighted digraph built with NumPy; replaced NetworkX dijkstra_path (pure Python) in review

synth_cegis.baseline: Z3 synthesis on a fixed random sample of 128 domain points (no counterexample feedback)
synth_cegis.competitor: Z3 on the full-domain encoding (all 2^n constraints at once, SMT-LIB text)

verify_modelcheck.baseline: random-walk testing, 10,000 steps in walks of 250; no violation seen is reported SAFE
verify_modelcheck.competitor: Z3 bounded model checking interleaved with k-induction, both to depth 15, one 4 s total budget
